Class FormPanel

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.swing.ui.FormPanel
public final class FormPanel extends Object
Lays out a form in two columns, with GridBagLayout, in the order its methods are called: rows of a label and its field, wide components across both columns, and section titles. Every cell has an inset of 4 pixels on each side, and the panel an empty border of 4 pixels. The wide components share the extra height; without one, the rows stay at the top of the panel.

The labels are typically Exposed fields of the view, so their texts and mnemonics come from its resources, as for any component.

Every method is called on the EDT. build() may be called once: any call afterwards throws IllegalStateException.
